name: deliberation-room
description: Multi-agent deliberation system for biblical commentary analysis

scripts.dev-model-default: npm run dev:css & sleep 3 ; npm run dev:server
scripts.dev:css: set -x ; pkill -f 'tailwindcss -i public/input.css -o public/compiled-style.css --watch --poll' ; npm run update-browsers-list ; tail -f /dev/null | npx tailwindcss -i public/input.css -o public/compiled-style.css --watch --poll
scripts.build:css: npm run update-browsers-list ; npx tailwindcss -i public/input.css -o public/compiled-style.css --minify
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run update-browsers-list && npx tailwindcss -i public/input.css -o /dev/null 2>&1
